entities.name: A0A348G5V9
observations: Exact 80-aa sequence match to reviewed U-poneritoxin(01)-Om3a from Odontomachus monticola; annotated as a secreted cationic amphipathic alpha-helical peptide.
Reference reports antimicrobial activity against E. coli (MIC 3.1 µM), S. aureus (25 µM), and S. cerevisiae (50 µM); histamine release 37.5% at 10 µM; no hemolysis observed through 50 µM.

Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight 8230.622 Da, theoretical pI 9.05, GRAVY 0.4125, calculated charge at pH 7 +1.5067. Pfam returned no domain result; this does not establish domain absence.
